node.title: Rate-half MCA global-core rank/support replacement target
node.closure: rank/common-zero regression; row-sharp near-MDS extension theorem required
node.statement: The former affine-rank and common-zero payments remain retracted. A corrected proper-subspace occupancy theorem pays all supports through affine rank 9 on KoalaBear and rank 1 on Mersenne and supplies exact higher-rank walls. A lifted-rank dichotomy splits each top cell into a gauge-drop branch and a full-lift branch. The latter is exactly a sparse full-affine-rank list in a codimension-one RS extension with d_1=e and every higher generalized weight MDS-sharp; the generic ceiling remains above budget. The printed middle-support intervals still require payment.
